title: Closure from bonds on the proposed inputs
claim: Test ternary first; extend on an affirmative criterion, then test numerical bond radius for the full update. Stop on a decisive obstruction at the current gate. Include both scaffold tests and a named lawful sample regardless.
standard_statement: In a connected multigraph with a distinguished exterior vertex, classify equality of its full degree with the number of marked exterior edges using the cardinalities of minimum bonds containing marked subsets. The opposite endpoints of a lawful multinary proposal have pairwise common neighbors and no single common neighbor.
prior_work: Known graphic bond and cut duality; the prior four-knot calculation. No cited result characterizes the closure predicate of this ordinary parity growth law, its optimal reading, and the conditional limits on its update.
source_contribution: A ternary input criterion, its extension and limits for the complete growth decision.
completion_gate: Test ternary first; extend on an affirmative criterion, then test numerical bond radius for the full update. Stop on a decisive obstruction at the current gate. Include both scaffold tests and a named lawful sample regardless.

validation.status: Independent in-task graph/constraint constructions and fresh computational replays. Independent program referee pending.

attained_result: Any one input pair decides a legal funded ternary on a connected ordinary parity stage. One query on p−1 arbitrary inputs suffices at arity p≥3 and is sharp under a total-input budget. Fixed numerical bond radius cannot determine complete growth.
